message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t determine a winner with the information given.  
In Texas Hold’em you need the five community cards (the flop, turn, and river) in addition to each player’s two hole cards to evaluate the best five‑card hand.  
Without those community cards, there’s no way to compare the hands and decide who wins. If you can provide the board cards, I’ll gladly figure out the winner for you.
